description: Free from Wires: Made for a peaceful typing experience the keyboard is free of wires. With 2.4 GHz wi-fi and Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity. So you can connect with the wireless keyboard at your will. Silent Typing: The soft rounded 78 keys offer a silent and smooth typing experience. Perfect for the office, academic and personal use. The laptop wireless keyboard with quick type and command responses without the usual clicking type noise made by other keyboards. Multiple Device Pairing: The keyboard wireless for laptops and PCs caters to multiple devices as it can be paired with smartphones and tablets via bluetooth. You can switch connections as well on the wireless keyboard by pressing the Fn + 1/2/3 keys to switch connections. Bubble is compatible with iOS devices iPhone and iPads and Android smartphones and tablets. Ergonomic design: The wireless keyboard for laptops and PCs weighs 276 grams, making it super light and portable. Take it to your cafe with your smartphone or tablet and work without the type of noise. Work from any place you find amusing.
